items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: So, while the band was eating supper, him and I was up there. So, he ran over the number. I played it good, that's all.

ctx.x: Yeah, then he came back a few years ago. Yeah, he got to come back new.

He been out two, three times since then. Yeah. This was in 1908. I was nothing, my feet couldn't, I used to have to put a set on a little stool like that. Well, you can sell it from my size there now for my feet to reach the thing. Yeah. So, while the band was eating supper, him and I was up there. So, he ran over the number.
